hopCourses.title: Star-hopping field courses
hopCourses.intro: Start at a familiar star and find your way to nebulae and clusters.
hopCourses.follow: Follow the chart in the real sky
hopCourses.record: Save what you saw in your observing log
hopCourses.realOnly: Confirm each leg during a real observation to complete the first step. Then save a ‘Seen’ observation to finish the course. Practice mode does not count.
hopCourses.longStep: Some legs exceed your current field. Move in overlapping fields using the chart. Your equipment’s field of view is never widened automatically.
